title: 🔥资金极致向头部汇聚
body: 市场处于结构收缩期。BTC.D 达 58.5%，7日涨幅 1.0%。资金并未随价格反弹扩散至山寨币，反而加速向头部资产回流。这种明显的“吸血效应”显示存量资金风险偏好极低，仅抱团高流动性资产。缺乏板块轮动信号，短期难言行情反转。中性。场外增量资金何时入场破局？
title_en: 🔥 Capital is Aggressively Rotating into Top-Tier Assets
body_en: The market is in a phase of structural contraction. BTC.D sits at 58.5%, up 1.0% over the last 7 days. Liquidity isn't spilling over into altcoins despite the price bounce; instead, it's accelerating back into major assets. This pronounced "liquidity vacuum" reveals that existing capital has extremely low risk appetite, preferring to crowd into high-liquidity plays. Without signs of sector rotation, a short-term trend reversal is unlikely. Neutral. The key question: when will fresh off-chain capital step in to break the stalemate?
